newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET IS NOT ON ACQUISITIVE PATH - CEO.
newsitem.headline: VALMET IS NOT ON ACQUISITIVE PATH - CEO.

text.p: The world's leading paper machine maker Valmet Oy has no plans to acquire any of its major competitors in the paper machine business, Valmet president and CEO Matti Sundberg said on Tuesday.
"I cannot even imagine that we would start chasing our competitors," Sundberg told a news conference, when asked whether Valmet had plans to acquire some of its competition.
"There has to be competition in this sector. We would get a lot of badwill if we did something like that," he added.
Sundberg said Valmet is the world's leader in paper machine business with more than 30 percent of the market.
Valmet's main competitors in the paper machine business are U.S. company Beloit, part of Harnischfeger group, and Swiss-German Voith-Sulzer.
